methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: Norfolk native brings free AI workshops to Hampton Roads to close the technology gap - WTKR
signals.signal_reading: Free AI workshops delivered by a Norfolk native directly target capability distribution in a non-metro region, building grassroots fluency that could enable peer-to-peer learning networks beyond traditional tech hubs.

signals.title: Roanoke College launches WorkAI Lab to prepare leaders for new era of technology - Roanoke College
signals.signal_reading: A WorkAI Lab at Roanoke College signals institutional investment in deep AI literacy outside NoVA, creating potential leadership pipeline in a mid-tier city that could replicate distributed capability development.

signals.title: After severe 76% electricity price hikes due to AI data centers, Virginia requires firms to pay for all dedicated upstream electrical infrastructure — state regulators crack down, governor says move will save civilians ‘hundreds of millions of dollars’ - Tom's Hardware
signals.signal_reading: Electricity rate hikes and new infrastructure cost requirements reveal how data center concentration in NoVA creates resource capture dynamics that materially disadvantage residential users, deepening the geographic benefits gap.

signals.title: Virginia Tech secures $20m NSF grant for AI-enabled semiconductor lab - Cleanroom Technology
signals.signal_reading: A $20M NSF grant for AI-enabled semiconductor research at Virginia Tech strengthens the New River Valley as a secondary excellence hub, but federal funding dependence suggests depth without broad regional distribution mechanisms.

signals.title: Tech Briefs: Radford University grads to hold EV truck company launch event Aug. 20
signals.signal_reading: An 'AI Decoded' event featuring a Blacksburg marketing studio founder signals practitioner-led knowledge sharing in a smaller market, suggesting entrepreneurial AI adoption outside metro centers that could seed peer learning networks.
